organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Departments, their hierarchy and members. Managers and primary departments decide who reviews "manager" approval steps; departments grant no permissions — use groups for access.

tree.label: Department tree
tree.searchPlaceholder: Search by department name or code

field.name: Name
field.codeHint: Optional; for imports and external systems. Letters, digits, - _ . only.

delete.title: Delete department
delete.confirm: Delete "{{name}}"? A department with sub-departments cannot be deleted. Memberships go to the trash with it and come back when it is restored.
delete.confirmNoTrash: Delete "{{name}}"? A department with sub-departments cannot be deleted. Memberships are deleted with it.

detail.emptyDescription: Pick a department from the tree to see its members and managers.

member.togglePrimary: This is the primary department of "{{name}}"
member.title: Job title
member.placeholder: Search for a user to add
member.removeConfirm: "{{name}}" will no longer belong to this department. If it is their primary department, they will have no manager for now.

chart.label: Org chart
chart.viewHint: Click a unit to see its details and members below.
chart.editHint: Press + under a unit to add a child; drag a line from a unit's bottom edge to another unit to change its parent; double-click to rename; select and press Delete to remove. Changes take effect when you save.
chart.blankName: Some units have a blank name. Double-click them to add a name before saving.
chart.cancelConfirm_one: The org chart has {{count}} unsaved change. Leaving edit mode discards it.
chart.cancelConfirm_other: The org chart has {{count}} unsaved changes. Leaving edit mode discards them all.
chart.deleteConfirm_one: {{count}} unit will be deleted when you save. Its memberships go to the trash with it.
chart.deleteConfirm_other: {{count}} units will be deleted when you save. Their memberships go to the trash with them.
chart.deleteConfirmNoTrash_one: {{count}} unit will be deleted when you save. Its memberships are deleted with it.
chart.deleteConfirmNoTrash_other: {{count}} units will be deleted when you save. Their memberships are deleted with them.
chart.deleteConfirmWithChildren_one: {{count}} unit will be deleted when you save. Its memberships go to the trash with it, and its remaining child units become top-level.
chart.deleteConfirmWithChildren_other: {{count}} units will be deleted when you save. Their memberships go to the trash with them, and their remaining child units become top-level.
chart.deleteConfirmWithChildrenNoTrash_one: {{count}} unit will be deleted when you save. Its memberships are deleted with it, and its remaining child units become top-level.
chart.deleteConfirmWithChildrenNoTrash_other: {{count}} units will be deleted when you save. Their memberships are deleted with them, and their remaining child units become top-level.
chart.deleteForbidden: You don't have permission to delete units
chart.orphanForbidden: Deleting this would move its child units, and you don't have permission to edit units
chart.saveFailed: Failed to {{step}} "{{name}}". The previous {{completed}} changes took effect; the chart now shows the current organization. Reason: {{reason}}
chart.outdated: Someone else changed the org chart while you were editing. Saving only sends your changes, but any unit you changed that was also changed by someone else will fail. You can also discard your draft and start over from the latest chart.
chart.deleteConflict: "{{names}}" was changed, deleted, or given new child units by someone else while you were editing. Nothing was saved so their changes aren't deleted. Reload the org chart and edit again.

transfer.membersOfUnit: Org unit members (selected unit and below)
